note: A fin being rolled in the 2D side view now stays on screen the whole way round: the part the airframe covers is drawn as a hidden line while the view is rolled, the way desktop OpenRocket's wireframe figure shows every fin at all times. Two earlier attempts hid it instead, which is why a fin appeared to blink rather than travel. The motor browser gains an impulse-class filter and an only-motors-that-fit checkbox, with propellant and out-of-production behind an All filters toggle; the Max motor length field gains an Estimate button that measures the room from the aft of the mount to the first obstruction; and the Aft view now shows for every rocket rather than only for pods and clusters. No numbers change.
